Bain & Company is developing a suite of cutting-edge data and software solutions designed to revolutionize how the private equity industry uses data for investment insights and decision-making.  

The PEG Innovation team's mission is to create analytical solutions for Bain clients, teams, and the broader institutional investor space using proprietary software and data products. This includes the development, commercialization, and daily management of Bain's proprietary datasets, data, and software businesses.

WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM

Full Stack Software Engineers build, ship, and operate the end-to-end products and shared platform services that power Bain's PE due diligence platform within PEG Engineering. You work across the entire stack: responsive React and Svelte frontends styled with Tailwind, Node.js (TypeScript, Express) and Python (FastAPI) backend services, RESTful and type-safe APIs, PostgreSQL data models, and the scheduled and event-driven jobs that keep data flowing. Our environment is deliberately polyglot and fast-moving, and we expect this engineer to be comfortable moving across languages, frameworks, and layers rather than staying in one lane.

A significant portion of this work is AI-enabled: integrating LLMs and agentic patterns into real analyst workflows through retrieval pipelines, structured outputs, streaming interfaces, and human-in-the-loop review. We weight strong engineering fundamentals as the foundation and treat AI as a reviewed co-pilot, not an autopilot. This is an engineering role in the full sense, we expect you to understand the problem, weigh approaches, and own the design and the outcome, not only produce code. AI accelerates the implementation, the engineering judgement behind it stays with you. Every AI-assisted change is expected to be understood, validated, and owned by the engineer who commits it.

You are expected to deliver production-quality code, write tests for the workflows you build, own features end-to-end, and partner with Product and Design to turn requirements into reliable user experiences. Engineers operate with increasing independence and breadth across the grade: earlier in the grade with guidance from senior engineers on the most complex or ambiguous work, and toward the upper end owning delivery independently, leading implementation of features, and providing technical guidance to peers and more junior engineers. Most of our systems run on Microsoft Azure, with some workloads on AWS. You collaborate with Platform Engineering for shared services such as Auth/RBAC, Audit, Notifications, and File handling, and with the AI teams to integrate intelligent features safely and correctly.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Product and Platform Delivery Across the Full Stack (80%) 

  • Build and maintain product UI features in React and Svelte with TypeScript and Tailwind, following established component patterns and the shared design system.

  • Design and implement RESTful and type-safe API contracts (Zod, Pydantic, OpenAPI codegen, or similar); own the contract boundary between frontend and backend services and manage consumer impact when it changes.

  • Build and operate scheduled and event-driven jobs (cron-based and queue-driven systems) for ingestion, enrichment, and background processing; make them idempotent, observable, and safe to re-run.
  • Integrate AI-enabled features into product workflows: LLM calls, retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, structured and streaming outputs, and human-in-the-loop review, following established safety and evaluation patterns.

Bain's B2B Commercial Excellence practice works with clients to develop a clear go-to-market (GTM) strategy: building an in-depth understanding of market opportunity, designing effective sales coverage and capacity models to attack that opportunity, and creating an industrialized sales execution capability to ensure commercial success. Coro's software and data solutions are an innovative and increasingly critical part of this approach. To learn more about Coro, visit https://www.coro.io/.

 

WHERE YOU'LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM

About Coro℠

The Coro℠ business unit brings together Bain's proprietary suite of software-as-a-service (SaaS) and data-as-a-service (DaaS) tools, including cloud-based software, online capability assessments, and advanced analytics, focused on enabling Commercial Excellence for B2B companies.

 

The Impact You'll Have

Bain's Commercial Excellence work helps B2B companies turn market opportunity into booked revenue, through sharper go-to-market strategy, better sales coverage and capacity, and industrialized execution. The analytics underneath that work are what make it credible, and they are what you will own.

We are hiring an Expert Senior Manager, Data Science, to lead data science delivery and methodology across Coro's product suite. You will set the analytical approach on our most complex client engagements, lead the teams that deliver them, and make the calls on modeling design, validation, and where a bespoke analysis should become a productized capability. This is a senior, client-facing role: you will work directly with Bain partners and client executives, and you will be the person expected to defend the methodology in the room.

These capabilities power Coro's product suite, such as MoneyMap®, which builds a granular, bottoms-up view of market opportunity, and the repeatable analytics workflows behind Bain's B2B go-to-market work, across challenges such as opportunity mapping, indirect channel growth, and profitability analysis. The work spans propensity and predictive scoring, TAM and market sizing, entity resolution and data matching across third-party sources, and GenAI-driven classification and enrichment at scale. The role also includes ownership of the analytics and delivery of our pricing products, including ProfitCube.

You will also help build the capability itself, through recruiting, coaching, and raising the standard of how the team works, in keeping with Bain's apprenticeship model. You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain's partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in commercial settings.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

You’ll join Bain’s Technology Insights Group (TIG), a rapidly growing global team of consultants and technologists. We work with leading private equity investors and their technology-enabled portfolio companies, acting as technical advisors throughout the investment lifecycle.

Our team conducts product and technology due diligence and value creation engagements, bringing together deep software expertise with a strong understanding of the commercial environments in which technology businesses operate. You’ll work alongside Bain consultants as well as experienced technology leaders, including former CPOs and CTOs of leading global technology and software companies.

The team has completed more than 400 product and technology diligence and value creation engagements worldwide and has supported clients on some of the most visible technology investments in the US and Europe in recent years.


WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM

As a Technologist – Expert Senior Manager, you’ll help scale a critical capability within Bain. You’ll work closely with global technology leadership and our regional Private Equity and General Consulting teams, bringing an experienced technical perspective to due diligence and value creation engagements.

You’ll assess some of the most interesting technology and technology-enabled businesses in the market, gaining exposure to a broad range of technologies, products and industries—including the rapidly evolving adoption of AI.

This position is based in London.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

You’ll act as a senior technologist and full member of the case leadership team across technology and integrated due diligence, post-acquisition—including Day 1 and the first 100 days—and value creation engagements.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the technical answer, working closely with case leadership to shape executive-level conclusions, key assumptions and assessments. You’ll take an answer-led approach grounded in the investment thesis for private equity clients or an operator perspective for corporate clients.
  • Evaluate product capabilities against the investment thesis, assess technical debt and architecture choices, identify material technology risks—including cybersecurity—and evaluate an R&D organization’s ability to execute.
  • Translate complex technical findings into a clear view of what needs to happen, the implications for the business and the likely investment required.
  • Serve as a senior technical voice in client discussions, management deep dives and conversations with target companies.
  • Lead deep dives into critical technical topics, drawing on Bain’s broader technologist community and expert network where specialist expertise is needed.
  • Help win new work by shaping proposals and engagement approaches and bringing strong technical credibility to client pitches.
  • Apply the investment thesis to technology due diligence and translate technical assessments into relevant business insights and recommendations.
  • Help develop TIG intellectual property and identify new opportunities for technology due diligence and value creation work.
  • Share your expertise with senior and junior colleagues, helping strengthen technology knowledge across Bain and with our clients.
  • Coach and mentor junior members of the TIG team.


ABOUT YOU

You bring substantial hands-on experience in commercial software engineering and architecture, combined with the ability to translate highly technical topics into clear business implications.

You’ll also bring:

  • 10+ years of relevant industry experience, including at least three years in leadership roles.
  • Recent, direct experience with AI-enabled software development lifecycles and the use of AI and generative AI in products, platforms or business processes.
  • Strong knowledge of software architecture, technology stacks, cloud and mobile computing, technical debt, functional and non-functional roadmaps, hosting, cybersecurity, databases, data and analytics, and AI/ML technologies.

  • The ability to work independently and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)

Bain’s AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.

The Impact You’ll Have

Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.


As an AI Engineer in AIS, you will build the technical core of these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.


The Role

The Lead AI Engineer will design, build, and ship generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. You will contribute across the full development lifecycle — from early experimentation and prototyping through to production deployment — collaborating closely with senior engineers, product managers, and data scientists. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with growing influence on technical direction and an opportunity to begin mentoring more junior team members.


You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.


Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn by doing, with support from experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.


 What You’ll Do

  • Contribute to the design, development, and deployment of end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
  • Build and iterate on multi-component AI pipelines, including:
    • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
    • Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
    • Embedding generation and optimization
    • Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
  • Implement reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across AI workflows
  • Build and contribute to agentic systems, applying sound engineering principles around separation of concerns, memory architecture, and tool integration
  • Contribute across the full stack: model experimentation, evaluation design, and production system deployment
  • Build and maintain APIs, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployments with attention to observability and reliability
  • Support and help build GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
  • Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
    • Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
    • Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
  • Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
  • Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
    • Hallucination rate and factual consistency
    • Relevance and precision/recall
    • Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
    • Cost tracking and efficiency
  • Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
  • Contribute technical insights and communicate findings clearly to cross-functional stakeholders and, where relevant, clients
  • Share knowledge with peers and support a culture of technical learning around RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

 

What We’re Looking For (Qualifications)

  • 3–5+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with hands-on building responsibilities
  • Demonstrated experience shipping generative AI features or systems end-to-end, from prototyping through production
  • Clear communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical collaborators and stakeholders
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and data science teams; some experience supporting or informally mentoring peers is a plus
  • Solid prompt engineering and context engineering skills; familiarity with conversation design principles
  • Working knowledge of evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM applications
  • Experience with:
    • RAG architectures (vector-based retrieval; exposure to hybrid or graph-based approaches is a plus)
    • Agentic patterns (tool use, routing, memory management; multi-agent systems experience is a plus)
    • ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
    • AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
  • Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
  • Familiarity with cost and latency tradeoffs when working with LLM workloads
  • Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
  • Eagerness to grow into a technical leadership role and support junior team members
  • Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus


Working Model & Travel

  • This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
  • Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

Proceed with Pride is Bain’s client selection and acceptance process. Developed in partnership with our Industry and Capability Practice Areas, it helps ensure we can be proud of the work we take on. When concerns arise, Partners are encouraged to engage the Proceed with Pride team for guidance and discussion.

The focus is nearly always on identifying the right mitigating actions to enable us to Proceed with Pride, although in some instances we will jointly decide not to proceed.

Regional Risk Officers (RROs) have been appointed to lead Regional Risk teams to align Proceed with Pride more closely with our line leadership. RROs are experienced, independent Advisory Partners and report to our Chief Risk Officer, who reports to the Board Risk Sub-Committee.

In this role, you will support the Senior Manager, APAC Client Risk, and the APAC RRO, helping to shape and execute the region’s approach to client selection and acceptance. You’ll be a key driver of strategic thinking and operational execution across risk efforts in the region.


Why you’ll want to join

  • Work at the intersection of ethics, reputation, and real-world events: Apply critical thinking to complex topics (e.g., geopolitics, regulatory scrutiny, sensitive sectors, AI), and support senior decision-making on whether and how Bain engages with clients and different types of work, balancing ethical and reputational trade-offs with integrity, while protecting Bain’s values and enabling responsible growth. 
  • Build a critical capability for Bain’s future: Proceed with Pride is a growing, evolving function – help shape how we manage emerging risk issues, expand our scope, and modernise how we operate at scale.
  • Direct exposure to senior leadership: Collaborate with Partners, Office Heads, Practice leaders, Legal, and PR/Comms, and support engagements with EMEA’s Regional Managing Partner (RMP) and Bain’s Board Risk Sub-Committee.
  • Have fun! Proceed with Pride is global, yet close-knit – be part of a collaborative and supportive team with a meaningful mission, a strong culture of camaraderie and plenty of opportunities for professional growth.


Key tasks

1. APAC  Client Selection and Acceptance Process – Lead and manage end-to-end risk assessments

  • Monitor the APAC opportunity pipeline to identify ‘higher risk’ cases flagged by risk guidelines, including work in regulated and reputationally sensitive sectors (e.g., gambling, sensitive areas of healthcare).
  • Confirm assessment requirements with Partners and facilitate in-depth discussions on client context and strategy, reputational considerations, and risk trade-offs.
  • Conduct relevant research, frame key questions, and coordinate input from Legal, PR, and other internal experts. 
  • Summarise decisions and mitigation plans, monitor implementation, and evaluate outcomes to protect Bain’s reputation and enable responsible growth.


2. Risk Awareness, Education & Engagement – Build and sustain a culture of risk mindfulness

  • Own and produce reporting on client risk and reputational themes across APAC, highlighting strategic implications and emerging external drivers.
  • Design and develop briefing materials and coordinate leadership updates for senior stakeholders (including APAC leadership and Practice Area Heads), strengthening Partners’ awareness of their role in client risk and reputation management for Bain.
  • Design agendas and run regular sessions with Practice Area Managers (PAMs) to build awareness, surface risks, and strengthen risk capabilities across teams, supporting consistent decision-making across the region.


3. Team Enablement & Innovation – Strengthen the Proceed with Pride team through scalable, forward-thinking solutions

  • Support initiatives to build and evolve the team’s purpose and mission, including leveraging AI to automate processes and improve insight generation.
  • Continuously refine frameworks and guidelines to remain effective in an ever-changing, volatile environment, reflecting evolving reputational expectations and strategic priorities.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve team efficiency, collaboration, and impact through innovative tools and approaches, enabling faster, higher-quality decisions.

  • Passion for governance and ethics, and for helping Bain decide which work to take on – strategically, reputationally, and responsibly – ensuring we can Proceed with Pride.

As a Manager, IT Auditor, you will hold a senior individual contributor role within the Internal Audit function, operating as part of the organization’s third line of defense. In this role, you will work closely with Global Internal Audit leadership, which reports directly into the Chief Risk Officer and the Board Risk Subcommittee. Your work will focus on providing independent assurance over the design and operating effectiveness of the organization’s technology processes and controls through risk-based audit engagements, delivering insights that help management strengthen technology processes, controls, and risk management practices. 

Perform and lead assigned IT audit engagements across technology risk areas such as cybersecurity, cloud environments, AI and generative AI, third-party risk, data governance, and IT operations. You will lead end-to-end audit engagements on a continuous or risk-based cycle throughout the year, bringing strong IT audit knowledge and a risk-based perspective to each engagement. The role carries no direct reports to start; you will coach team members on engagements, with the opportunity to take on formal supervisory responsibility as the function grows. 

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

Audit Planning & Execution 

  • Lead assigned IT audit engagements within the approved annual audit plan, developing risk-based audit procedures and testing approaches consistent with established audit methodology and risk priorities. 
  • Assess the governance and controls around AI and generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot), acceptable use, data privacy, model and vendor due diligence, human-in-the-loop review, and output validation. 
  • Design audit programs, end-to-end process walkthroughs, test procedures, and sampling strategies tailored to the risk profile of each engagement. 
  • Test core IT general controls, covering logical access and periodic user access reviews, change and configuration management, IT operations and job scheduling, and backup and recovery. 
  • Test cybersecurity controls, covering vulnerability and patch management, security monitoring and threat detection, identity and access security, and incident response readiness. 
  • Audit data governance and oversight, including data ownership and stewardship, classification and retention, data quality controls, traceability and access rights, and the effectiveness of governance forums in exercising oversight over data use. 
  • Identify process gaps and control design weaknesses and recommend sustainable, repeatable control improvements to process owners. 
  • Review the software development lifecycle, including design approval, secure coding, testing and UAT, release management, segregation of duties, and post-implementation review.

Governance & Stakeholder Engagement 

  • Present audit findings, recommendations, and status updates to senior internal management. 
  • Provide guidance to stakeholders on IT audit findings, control effectiveness, and identified technology risks. 
  • Collaborate with the first and second lines of defense to understand and support alignment on established control objectives and risk tolerances. 
  • Recommend improvements to key controls in collaboration with process and control owners, identify opportunities to reduce duplicative or low-value controls and recommend appropriate improvements, and identify opportunities to improve continuous control monitoring and automated testing. 
  • Coordinate with external certification bodies, assessors, and third-parties in support of external certification and attestation programs (e.g., CMMC, ISO 27001, SOC 1/SOC 2), including readiness assessments, evidence requests, and findings follow-up.

Reporting & Issue Management 

  • Produce high-quality internal audit reports with clear, risk-rated findings and actionable recommendations. 
  • Perform root-cause analysis on control failures, distinguishing design gaps from execution breakdowns so remediation addresses the underlying process rather than the symptom. 
  • Monitor remediation progress, assess management action plans, validate completion of agreed actions, and report status to relevant stakeholders. 
  • Maintain audit documentation in accordance with IIA Standards and internal quality assurance requirements.

Collaboration & Development 

  • Coach and support team members during assigned audit engagements and provide feedback to promote consistent application of audit methodology. 
  • Peer review workpapers and support consistent application of established audit methodology across assigned engagements. 
  • Contribute to enhancements to IT audit tools, analytics, and audit practices, including appropriate use of AI-enabled automation to support audit planning, testing, and reporting.

BCN Private Equity Group CoE at Bain & Company provides specialized support to global teams across the private equity value chain, enabling clients to make key investment decisions. In the last decade, we have witnessed an exponential growth, reaching >250 members today from ~10 members in 2013. Understand Users & Identify What to Build
Own 2–3 products/modules within the Survey Toolkit, develop deep understanding of Survey CoE workflows, gather and synthesise user feedback, and translate business problems into clear product requirements with defined success measures.

Own Requirements, Backlog & Prioritisation
Maintain the product backlog, write epics, user stories and acceptance criteria, prioritise features based on user impact and business value, and ensure the engineering squad always has clarity on what to build and why.

Drive Product Delivery

Shape AI-Enabled Experiences

Position overview


Bain’s Primary Research capability supports high-quality insight generation for client teams through a broad ecosystem of external research partners, including expert networks, survey providers, specialist research vendors, and other third-party partners. The Manager, Vendor Management, will support category management, quality and risk-related initiatives, commercial and performance tracking, stakeholder communications, and operational improvement efforts.


The ideal candidate is a strong Manager-level operator who can bring structure to ambiguity, coordinate across multiple stakeholders, manage complex vendor workstreams, and translate priorities into practical execution.


Why this role matters


Primary Research is an important capability for Bain, helping teams develop distinctive market, customer, and expert perspectives. As research channels become more complex, Bain’s ability to manage a high-performing vendor ecosystem, maintain quality standards, and support efficient research operations is increasingly important to delivering client impact.


Key responsibilities


Support the ongoing management of Bain’s external research vendor portfolio, including expert networks, specialist research vendors, and other third-party partners.

Oversee recurring vendor management activities, including business reviews, performance check-ins, issue-resolution meetings, and commercial follow-ups.

Track vendor performance against agreed service, quality, compliance, operational, and commercial expectations.

Support vendor selection, onboarding, renewal, amendment, and offboarding processes in partnership with relevant internal stakeholders.

Support innovation initiatives that improve the quality, consistency, efficiency, and scalability of Primary Research operations.

Translate priorities into structured workplans with clear owners, timelines, risks, dependencies, and decision points.

Prepare clear updates that summarize progress, key risks, decisions required and recommended next steps.

Build trusted working relationships with internal stakeholders across business, research, Legal, Risk & Compliance, Finance, technology, and client-service teams.

Support communications with external vendors, including meeting preparation, follow-up notes, action tracking, and issue escalation.


Required qualifications


Manager-level experience in vendor management, operations, contingent workforce planning, professional services, consulting operations, external talent management, product operations, or a related field.

Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex workstreams simultaneously.

Strong project management and organizational skills, with ability to translate ambiguous problems into clear plans, owners, and next steps.

Strong written communication skills, with ability to prepare concise, structured, senior-ready materials.

Strong stakeholder management skills, including ability to coordinate across teams with different priorities and incentives.

Analytical comfort with vendor performance, spend, usage, operational metrics, and issue tracking.

Commercial judgment and comfort supporting vendor negotiations, contract tracking, and performance discussions.

High attention to detail and strong follow-through.


Preferred qualifications


Experience with expert networks, primary research, survey vendors, external talent providers, professional services vendors, or knowledge/research operations.

Experience supporting risk, compliance, fraud prevention, vendor quality, or third-party management initiatives.

Experience working with product, data, or technology teams on business requirements, tool adoption, or operational enablement.

Experience in consulting, private equity support, diligence operations, or other client-service environments.

Experience preparing leadership-level updates or executive communications.

Comfort working globally across time zones and stakeholder groups.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys taking initiative. Rather than waiting for something to be raised, you’ll proactively identify what needs attention and take action to resolve it.

You’ll also support our reception function, stepping in to provide reception coverage when required, and help with client meetings, interviews, events, new joiners, and other office activities.

Keep Our Office Running Smoothly

  • Ensure spaces are tidy, welcoming, well organized, and appropriately stocked
  • Prepare and reset meeting rooms before and after internal meetings, client visits, and interviews
  • Monitor office and kitchen supplies and place orders in line with agreed budgets and guidelines
  • Ensure office equipment such as coffee machines and printers is working effectively, resolving minor issues or coordinating external support when required
  • Work with cleaning contractors, suppliers, and other service providers to resolve day-to-day issues

Support Reception & Visitors

  • Provide reception coverage during breaks, absences, and other periods as needed
  • Welcome clients, candidates, and other visitors in a warm and professional manner
  • Answer incoming calls and respond appropriately to requests
  • Arrange couriers and taxis
  • Manage meeting room bookings and coordinate catering requirements
  • Understand office security, keys, access systems, alarms, and safety procedures and provide guidance to colleagues when required


Support Meetings, Interviews & Events

  • Prepare rooms and facilities for client meetings, interviews, and internal activities

  • Support printing, binding, and other meeting preparation when required

You’re someone who notices the details others might miss and enjoys creating a great experience for the people around you. You’re comfortable taking ownership of your work, responding quickly when priorities change, and getting things done in a busy environment.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Good organizational skills and the ability to manage tasks accurately and efficiently
  • A proactive approach and confidence taking initiative without waiting to be asked
  • Strong attention to detail and high standards for quality
  • The flexibility to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • A professional, positive, and approachable manner
  • A collaborative mindset and willingness to support the wider team
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams

JobTitle: AI & Digital Products Consultant (Strategy & Transformation Practice)
JobDescription:
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

 

Bain has formalized industry and capability “Practices” that are integral to how Bain wins and delivers results to its clients. Together they form our Product, Practice, and Knowledge ("PPK") team. The role of a Practice is to drive growth for Bain in a particular industry or capability together with offices, and boost Bain’s expertise and commercial excellence.  

The Strategy & Transformation Practice is one of the largest practices at Bain, and at the heart of some of our biggest client success stories. We’re constantly pushing the boundaries of innovation, with new hooks, points of view, products, tools and delivery models that bring together the best thinking from our most successful client heads and senior strategists, to stretch our client’s definition of full potential, embed change within their organizations, and deliver results. The Strategy & Transformation Practice team works very closely with partners, senior managers and teams to bring Bain’s best experience and the latest tools and innovations to bear across sectors and offices. They are integral in helping Bain win new cases and advising our case teams on difficult strategy and transformation questions.   

The Strategy Practice Consultant role is part of our Business & Corporate Strategy solution team, which consists of two Global Solution Leaders, a Global Solution & IP VP, a Practice Director, a Solution Technical Product Manager, a Solution Innovation Practice Senior Manager, multiple Practice Managers, Consultants and BCN who collectively manage the overall solution IP, IP/tool development, and commercial deployment, and a knowledge management team. The role focuses on turning our Bain IP and differentiated capabilities into practical, high-impact approaches and AI-enabled tools (housed within the “Full Potential Co-Pilot” suite of S&T tools) for frontline partners and strategy case teams. You will be helping Bain stay at the forefront of innovation, harnessing technology to enhance the way we solve strategic business problems. 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

 

The Strategy Practice Consultant role is a critical one for the Strategy & Transformation Practice, supporting Strategy product and IP development and deployment, and client and case team support. The individual will help drive our solution modernization efforts, with a focus on the development of innovative technology solutions that embed into the Strategy solutions, working closely with the rest of the practice team and others innovating on AI tools within Bain. 

1) Solution Incubation: Help discover, prototype, and scale high-value tools as part of the Full Potential Co-Pilot suite of S&T-driven use cases 

  • Identify and prioritize opportunities for AI modules for prototyping through frontline learnings 
  • Help translate IP and business logic into prototypes of proprietary tools to be tested using no/low-code platforms (e.g., Claude skills); evaluate outputs and iterate on tools, in partnership with Solution Innovation SM 
  • Work with the solution team to continuously evolve all S&T-owned modules (prompts, data calls, guardrails, etc.) based on ongoing evals and pattern recognition from frontline use 
  • Collaborate with Knowledge Management team to curate and harness “citizen innovation” that happens within Strategy case teams, integrating high value tools into the standard workflow / platform for reuse across Bain 

2) Tool Deployment / Team Support: Work with practice team to embed AI tools and insights into case team engagements  

  • Support high-priority Strategy pitches with cutting-edge AI insights 
  • Partner with case teams to weave AI tools into live engagements from day one 
  • Identify case team innovations that should be scaled  
  • Track usage and outcome metrics and circulate best practices across case teams 

3) Marketing and Training: Help drive firm-wide awareness and adoption of Strategy tools and innovation 

  • Work with solution team to embed tools into Strategy approach, core IP collateral, Iris/Sage 
  • Lead hands-on trainings to boost adoption and confidence across Bain’s Strategy General Consulting staff and Practice team 
  • Create demo videos, one-pagers and pitch decks to market the practice’s tools 
  • Maintain usage dashboards and success stories 

4) Solution Innovation Strategy: Help shape the vision, priorities, and roadmap for solution innovation, working closely with the Solution Innovation SM, Global Solution Leaders, Global Solution and IP VP, Solution Technical Product Manager and other key stakeholders 

  • Help coordinate collaboration efforts with key stakeholders and resource groups across Bain including the Core Innovation Team, Vector, Umbrage, BCN/BCN Labs, Modernize Bain and S&T Leadership 
  • Conduct ongoing research to monitor competitor offerings and tech/AI advancements and translate into insights that inform product roadmap and investment decisions 

ABOUT YOU 

  • 5-8 years technical product development experience in a similar industry with an undergraduate degree OR 4-5 years experience with MBA/Master’s OR MBB consulting experience at the Senior Associate or Consultant level OR Senior Consultant Level at other management consulting firms 
  • Strong understanding of AI/ML technologies and tools (e.g., Python, R, OpenAI APIs), and extensive experience building AI-enabled tools that create business value 
  • Analytical and problem- solving skills and expertise to push insights to conclusive recommendations 
  • Ability to effectively drive a piece of work end-to-end with limited direction 
  • Continuously learns from one experience to another and makes thoughtful recommendations on improvements 
  • Excellent verbal and written skills in English Language at a C1 level 
  • Structure and design impactful slides and written updates; can clearly communicate insights and implications of work to senior stakeholders at the right level of detail 
  • Steer and direct highly effective small meetings; participates in meetings with more senior stakeholders and appropriately shares opinion 
  • Track record of inspiring, motivating, and apprenticing junior team members 
  • Flexibility to work outside usual business hours to accommodate for the global nature of the role working across timezones

WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

Over the past two decades, Bain has formalized Industry and Capability areas, internally known as “Practices”, integral to how Bain wins and delivers results to its clients. A Practice can be considered a Business Unit of Bain & Company. While there may be some allocation to client-facing work, the role within a Practice is primarily focused on supporting our client-facing partners and case teams to deliver great client and people success stories. Specifically, the Practice defines and implements their own strategy and allocates resources to: 

  • Boosts Bain’s knowledge and expertise in the sector or capability: co-create, shape and manage innovative perspectives and products to help the business win more projects, and to serve clients more effectively and efficiently.
  • Prioritize clients and enable client full potential.
  • Develop partner team and capabilities.
  • Build the practice’s brand and reputation externally.

You’ll work with the Supply Chain & Manufacturing Practice Team, a global group that supports the Supply Chain & Manufacturing capability. This practice belongs to Bain’s overall Performance Improvement Capability. 

Supply chains are undergoing unprecedented transformation due to global disruptions, increasing digitization, rising customer expectations, and the push for more sustainable, resilient operations. The Global Supply Chain practice at Bain helps clients solve a broad range of challenges, always connecting their supply chain operations to their overall strategy. Key areas Bain supports includes supply chain strategy and design, network optimization, integrated business planning, fulfillment & logistics, supply chain resiliency, digitization, automation, and ESG integration. We partner with leading companies across industries to build future-ready supply chains and unlock value through operational excellence.

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

This is not a traditional consulting role.

Here, you’ll operate at the intersection of strategy, innovation, and capability building—with the opportunity to develop deep expertise while still working on high-impact business problems.

As a Practice Consultant (Supply Chain & Manfacturing), you’ll support

  • Commercial and case delivery efforts: solution design, development, deployment and delivery of Bain’s thought leadership and IP across priority supply chain themes and selected products through research, data analysis (of proprietary, primary, and secondary data), and expert input from Bain partners and advisors. Advise client teams using the IP and ensure that emerging insights and frontline innovations are continuously integrated
  • Build expertise: Develop a broad understanding of the Supply Chain practice and establish personal expertise in select priority areas (e.g., planning, digital supply chain, fulfilment, etc.) 
     
  • Client support: Assist with client development efforts, proposals, and provide direct support to consulting teams using Bain’s supply chain IP
     
  • IP development and commercialization: Actively contribute to IP deployment internally (building awareness and enablement) and externally (marketing content, conference support, partner preparation) via global reports, research briefs, market overviews, and solution specific materials
     
  • Ecosystem management: Work with the broader Supply Chain & Manufacturing practice team to help manage and improve the impact of our ecosystem of external partnerships, internal collaborators (e.g., Marketing, Business Development, etc.), and specialized delivery resources (e.g., Advanced Analytics, Supply Chain Center of Excellence, etc.) 
     
  • Practice operations: Support planning and execution of recurring meetings, business operations, and priority evens such as Bain’s annual Commercial Acceleration meetings and Global Leadership Summit—helping shape agendas, coordinate speakers, and present IP
     
  • Knowledge capture: Working collaboratively with our Knowledge Management team, prioritize, synthesize, and share learnings from the field to enhance Bain’s supply chain knowledge base
     
  • Coaching & mentorship: Support talent development of broader Supply Chain team and mentor junior team members in our Knowledge Management (KM) teams, both in their traditional KM roles, but also as developing practice members in supply chain
  •  
  • Demonstrate leadership: Be a key member of the Global Supply Chain & Manufacturing practice team and a role model for collaboration, innovation, and professionalism

ABOUT YOU

Required:

  • BA or equivalent, MBA preferred
  • 4 years of professional working experience, with 1-2 years of current or recent consulting experience at the Consultant level with a leading consulting firm
  • Supply Chain / Operations experience, either during consulting projects or within industry
  • Strong problem definition and problem-solving skillset
  • Ability to quickly understand, structure, and lead complex business research and analysis in a fast-paced environment, as well as the skills to drive to pragmatic business insights 
  • Excellent analytical capabilities and experience using complex modeling and analysis to inform key business decisions (strong Excel skills)
  • Demonstrated organizational / time management skills
  • A proven self-starter with the ability to operate independently and manage competing priorities with minimal supervision 
  • Comfortable and effective working with what could be a remote supervisor and team in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience and proficiency creating high quality presentations 
  • Excellent oral, written, and PowerPoint communication skills
  • Ability to work well with all levels within Bain and at client
  • Ability to lead interactions and establish credibility with senior stakeholders (at Bain or Client)

Preferred:

  • Experience in project management
  • Prior experience using tools to analyze and visualize large datasets (e.g., Alteryx, Tableau)

WHAT BAIN CAN OFFER YOU

The Practice Consultant role offers the ability to apply the many favorable aspects of a traditional consulting role (strategic thinking, problem solving, business judgment, change management, driving for results) with less travel and more flexibility, including the following professional opportunities:

  • Develop deep supply chain expertise
    • Build and deepen expertise in supply chain and operations in a focused way, contributing to Bain’s thought leadership and client impact
    • Create provocative, leading-edge IP in this highly dynamic area and globally relevant area
    • Partner closely with core client delivery affiliates to better serve clients, capture IP, and improve our ecosystem of support 
  • Broaden your skillset
    • Develop operational skills through practice operations and leadership
    • Strengthen commercialization capabilities by supporting marketing and branding efforts
    • Progressive career opportunity with a clear career path within Bain toward Practice Manager and beyond
    • Flexibility to transition into capability or product-focused roles as needed
  • Work with a great team
    • Join a high-performing global Supply Chain practice team
    • Collaborate with experienced Bain partners and content experts
    • Be part of the wider Product, Practice, and Knowledge (PPK) community

JobDescription:

WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the #1 ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor’s list since its founding in 2009.

They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH 

You’ll join Bain’s Healthcare & Life Sciences Center of Expertise as part of the Bain Capability Network. This full-time role is based in Bain’s Mexico office and supports global consulting teams across the healthcare and life sciences value chain, helping clients make strategic business and investment decisions.

The Healthcare & Life Sciences Center of Expertise partners closely with case teams as a thought partner, delivering high-quality, industry-specific analytical products and expertise to address the most critical strategic questions facing Bain’s healthcare clients. The practice serves leading organizations across Pharmaceuticals, MedTech, Providers, Payers, Global Health and Digital Health.

As a Project Leader, you’ll collaborate with teams across major regions, with a primary focus on the Americas. You’ll work closely with global Bain teams to deliver client-ready insights, proposals, case-specific outputs, go-to-market materials, intellectual property and thought leadership in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM  

As a Project Leader, you’ll lead a team of 3–4 Associates and Analysts focused on two or more core healthcare domains, including Pharmaceuticals, MedTech, Payers, Providers and Services. You’ll be responsible for high-quality project delivery, strong client relationships, and day-to-day coaching and mentoring.

You’ll help your team set direction, build workplans, shape problem-solving approaches, generate hypotheses, and use Bain’s research toolkit to deliver practical, high-impact answers for clients. You’ll also contribute to Bain’s internal capabilities, including intellectual property, thought leadership, recruiting, training and business strategy initiatives.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead case and proposal engagements across the healthcare landscape, including Pharmaceuticals, MedTech, Payers, Providers and Services
  • Collaborate with Partners and case teams to deliver active client work and develop domain-specific, client-ready proposals
  • Engage with practice leadership on existing intellectual property and help identify opportunities to develop new products and IP for healthcare clients
  • Build the team’s understanding of healthcare concepts, pharmaceutical value chains and relevant IP
  • Drive structured problem solving and storytelling for client situations, ensuring alignment with Bain’s quality standards
  • Provide direct, day-to-day management and coaching for a team of 3–4 members with limited guidance from the Manager
  • Ensure timely, high-quality delivery by defining deliverables, shaping workplans, prioritizing timelines, reviewing team output and maintaining quality control
  • Identify critical project and client issues, proactively resolve problems, remove roadblocks and escalate issues when needed
  • Use relevant analytical tools to deliver zero-defect workstreams; where appropriate, leverage Tableau, Alteryx, Python, R or SPSS to improve team efficiency
  • Foster collaboration across BCN and global Bain teams to promote knowledge sharing
  • Own and maintain client relationships by understanding client needs, adapting to case expectations, communicating insights clearly and recommending actionable solutions
  • Manage client and team meetings effectively, delivering clear and professional presentations to teams, team leaders, managers and Partners across Bain
  • Develop and retain top talent through coaching, training, development plans, recognition, actionable feedback and performance review support
  • Serve as a role model and ambassador of Bain’s culture by building trust-based relationships across levels

 

 

ABOUT YOU

  • Willing and able to work in a hybrid set-up, with 4 days per week on-site (Bain office in Polanco) or at a client location
  • Bachelor’s degree with 5–8 years of experience, or master’s/postgraduate degree with 3–6 years of experience; healthcare-related focus preferred, with experience in consulting, business research, or analytics for pharmaceutical, MedTech, or healthcare clients.
  • Proficient in written and spoken English at C1–C2 level, with strong stakeholder communication skills
  • Strong academic record, analytical skills, and experience in consulting, proposal development, or client-ready delivery, preferably within Healthcare & Life Sciences
  • Deep understanding of the pharmaceutical value chain, MedTech, and broader Healthcare & Life Sciences sectors
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and motivate teams, deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines, and balance attention to detail with effective delegation
  • Strong problem-solving and project management skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and turn open-ended ideas into practical, actionable results
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to support senior client and stakeholder discussions and build trusted working relationships across functions and geographies
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with the ability to develop structured, high-impact outputs
  • Ability to travel regionally as needed; travel frequency and destinations will vary based on project needs

Who you will work with 

OPEXEngine, a Bain & Company solution, is a proprietary B2B SaaS benchmarking database covering 1,200+ participating SaaS companies, 250+ metrics, and 130,000+ validated data points. The platform ingests customer submissions, calculates financial, SaaS, go-to-market, headcount, and operating expense metrics, and publishes cohort-level benchmarks that Bain case teams and external customers use to identify performance gaps and prioritize where to improve.

The Senior Associate will work as a hands-on data engineer on the OPEXEngine data team, supporting end-to-end delivery across data ingestion and validation, metric calculation, and cohort and benchmark creation, while ensuring high-quality, scalable, and reliable data solutions.


What you’ll do 

This role requires strong hands-on experience in SQL, Python, relational data modeling, and data warehousing. The candidate will design and implement data pipelines, data models, and validation workflows, and is expected to scope features and make architecture decisions rather than execute only within a pre-defined scope.

The role includes active participation in project planning, stakeholder communication, and quality assurance to support timely delivery of high-impact work. Full-week coverage is required, with overlap into US working hours to support the onshore team.

The BCN Senior Associate will work closely with team managers, OPEXEngine Strategy & Ops leadership, Bain case teams, and external customers to build and deliver scalable, automated, and commercially relevant data solutions.

The working style of the team is centered on scalable product and capability development; therefore, pipelines and data solutions built in this role should be robust, automated, and designed for long-term maintainability. The individual should also be comfortable creating structure in ambiguity.

Essential Functions:
  • Validate incoming customer submissions for structural accuracy and consistency with the OPEXEngine taxonomy, flagging exceptions for review.
  • Load validated responses into the OPEXEngine database and action corrections arising from customer feedback or direction from Strategy & Ops.
  • Write and optimize SQL-based queries and transformations to support metric calculations, data checks, and deliverables for Bain case teams and external customers.
  • Operationalize the annual benchmarking cycle: build cohorts from defined selection criteria, calculate benchmarks and quartiles, validate the output, and ensure it is published to the platform.
  • Design and execute data cleaning rules that improve structural validity across the benchmark database.
  • Scope, design, and build platform features that strengthen the data pipeline, such as validation tooling that flags taxonomy breaks and percentile performance views across the database.
  • Make schema and architecture decisions across the ingestion, metric calculation, and benchmarking pipeline, ensuring solutions are scalable, automated, and maintainable.
  • Gather business requirements and process knowledge from Strategy & Ops, and translate them into scalable data models, transformations, and outputs aligned to end-user needs.
  • Investigate data issues within the pipeline, identify root causes, communicate implications to stakeholders, and propose effective solutions.
  • Prepare clear technical and process documentation for ongoing maintenance, knowledge transfer, and future reference.
  • Manage communication with onshore teams and stakeholders regarding project progress, data quality, and key insights.
  • Support project planning and resource management, including prioritization, work allocation, and tracking progress across concurrent initiatives.
  • Provide technical guidance and day-to-day support to junior team members, review output for quality, and drive reusable capability building through shared assets, frameworks, and documentation standards.


About you

Work experience: 6+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Management, Business Intelligence, or Business Analytics, with strong hands-on experience in SQL, Python, data warehousing, and relational database design.

Education Required: Incumbent should be a graduate/post graduate from a top-tier institute or have pursued a statistical/analytical course from a tier 1 university.

Preferred: Concentration in a quantitative discipline such as Engineering, Computer Science, Econometrics, Business Analytics, or Market Research is strongly preferred.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:

  • Advanced SQL knowledge (complex queries, stored procedures, performance tuning, optimization, etc.).
  • Strong hands-on Python for data processing, validation, automation, and scripting.
  • Strong understanding of ETL concepts, data warehousing principles, and relational database architecture, with hands-on experience on SQL server or a comparable relational database.
  • Working knowledge of cloud technologies, preferably AWS (e.g., EC2, RDS, CloudWatch).
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, schema design, and scalable data pipeline architecture.
  • Ability to independently scope features, design solutions, and make architecture decisions, including where requirements start out ambiguous.
  • Experience with Git-based version control and CI/CD workflows; GitLab experience preferred.
  • Experience coordinating projects, managing resources, and driving execution across multiple stakeholders.
  • Ability to provide technical leadership, coach junior team members, and review output for quality and accuracy.
  • Strong organizational skills, including planning, prioritization, and time management.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
  • Passion for solving complex data problems and working with large, diverse data sets.
  • Ability to quickly learn new tools, technologies, and business contexts.
  • Good to have (not mandatory): SaaS domain expertise or P&L fluency, and prior experience with benchmarking or survey-based data sets.
  • Good to have (not mandatory) : familiarity with PHP or JavaScript/React for full-stack contribution, and exposure to LLM/API integration.

About you

Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related technical fields.
/ 4–7 years of experience in building and deploying scalable data, analytics, or digital solutions in production environments.
/ Proven experience in leading small to mid-sized teams, mentoring junior members, and driving end-to-end project delivery.
/ Strong programming skills in Python (preferred) and working knowledge of SQL; familiarity with software engineering best practices.
/ Hands-on experience with data platforms, cloud ecosystems (AWS/Azure/GCP), and modern data architectures (data lakes, warehouses, APIs).
/ Experience designing end-to-end solutions including data pipelines, backend services, and frontend applications or dashboards (e.g., React,NextJS or similar frameworks).
/ Familiarity with DevOps practices (CI/CD, containerization using Docker, version control using Git).
/ Strong understanding of system design, scalability, performance optimization, and data modeling.
/ Ability to translate business problems into technical solutions and architecture designs.
/ Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
/ Prior exposure to consulting or working in cross-functional teams is a plus.

Who you will work with

The Consumer Products Center of Expertise collaborates with Bain’s global Consumer Products Practice leadership, client-facing Bain leadership and teams, and with end clients on development and delivery of Bain’s proprietary CP products and solutions. These solutions aim to answer strategic questions of Bain’s CP clients relating to brand strategy (consumer needs, assortment, pricing, distribution), revenue growth management (pricing strategy, promotions, profit pools, trade terms), negotiation strategy with key retailers, optimization of COGS etc.

You will work as part of the team in CP CoE comprising of a mix of Director, Managers, Projects Leads, Associates and Analysts working to implement cloud-based end-to-end advanced analytics solutions. Delivery models on projects vary from working as part of a CP Center of Expertise, broader global Bain case team within the CP ringfence, or within other industry CoEs such as FS / Retail / TMT / Energy / CME / etc with BCN on need basis.

What you’ll do

/ Design and build scalable, production-grade data and analytics solutions, including data pipelines, backend services, and user-facing applications.
/ Architect end-to-end technical solutions by combining data engineering, backend development, and frontend interfaces/dashboards.
/ Lead project workstreams and manage small teams of engineers/analysts, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.
/ Mentor junior team members, conduct code reviews, and drive adoption of engineering best practices.
/ Collaborate closely with data scientists to productionize models and integrate them into robust, scalable systems.
/ Develop and maintain APIs and data services to enable seamless consumption of data and analytics outputs.
/ Build lightweight frontend applications or dashboards to enable business users to interact with data and insights.
/ Deploy and manage solutions on cloud platforms (AWS/Azure), ensuring performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
/ Implement best practices in DevOps including CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), and monitoring/logging frameworks.
/ Optimize data workflows and system performance for large-scale data processing and real-time/near real-time applications.
/ Work with business stakeholders to understand problem statements and translate them into scalable technical architectures.
/ Contribute to development of reusable technical assets, accelerators, and Bain intellectual property.
/ Support client discussions by articulating technical approaches and trade-offs in a clear and structured manner.

What you’ll do

/ The SA is expected to have a knack for seeking out challenging problems, leading a team and producing their own ideas, which they will be encouraged to brainstorm with their peers and managers. They should be willing to learn new techniques and be open to solving problems with an interdisciplinary approach. They must have excellent coding skills and should demonstrate a willingness to write modular, reusable, and functional code.

PPK Reporting & Analytics CoE has experienced strong growth as an internal business intelligence and analytics business over the years.   • Assist in developing specific parts of reporting solutions using Tableau, and similar tools, working under the guidance of Senior Specialists to ensure outputs meet project needs.

  • Lead across the product team — Act as primary product counterpart to Survey CoE stakeholders; coach and develop Product Owners; establish consistent PM practices across squads; communicate direction and trade-offs clearly to senior leadership.

About You

An experienced product manager with strong user orientation, structured problem-solving, and sound commercial and technical judgment. Comfortable owning ambiguous problems, setting team direction, and operating at both the strategic and execution level simultaneously. Credible working with engineers and technical specialists on feasibility and trade-offs.

You will own the management of deployments for assigned clients and support senior team members with more complex deployments or high-priority cases or clients. Company Profile

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefine industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.

The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

 

What makes us a great place to work

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. 

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

 

Job Summary

We are hiring a Software Engineer to solve real business problems for the functions that keep Bain running. From Finance to Legal, HR, Risk, and more you will build full-stack software, AI agents, integrations, and workflow products that turn messy, ambiguous business needs into reliable, working software. You will partner closely with the people who use what you ship ensuring it is correct, reliable, maintainable, and clearly communicated.

This role suits high-initiative builders with strong software fundamentals who treat AI as a force multiplier - using it not only to deliver more, but to deliver faster, more efficiently, and to a higher standard.

What Makes This Role Different

  • You will work on real business problems with users close enough to give fast feedback.
  • You will use AI development tools as part of the normal engineering workflow, not as a side experiment.
  • You will be encouraged to compress the path from idea to working software without lowering the engineering bar.
  • You will build across the stack: frontend, backend, data, APIs, integrations, and agentic workflows.
  • You will be expected to ship quickly while still writing code that another engineer can understand, test, and extend.
  • You will learn across domains instead of specializing only in one platform or one automation tool.

What You Will Build

  • Internal tools that turn messy business processes into structured, trackable workflows.
  • AI agents that draft, check, route, summarize, or monitor work with appropriate human review.
  • Full-stack applications for Bain teams that need reliable software, not one-off scripts.
  • Integrations across documents, tickets, databases, collaboration tools, and internal platforms.
  • Prototypes that move quickly and can be hardened into maintainable production systems when the value is proven.

Principal Accountabilities and % of time

Build full-stack solutions (45%)

Own contained projects and features from problem clarification through launch. Build backend services, frontend interfaces, data models, APIs, integrations, and workflow logic that solve practical business problems.


Use AI to accelerate delivery (20%)

Use tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Replit, or similar tools to plan, code, test, debug, document, and refactor. Validate AI output before it reaches users.


Translate business ambiguity into software (15%)

Clarify user needs, prioritize MVP features, ask probing questions, and choose practical technical approaches. Partner with senior engineers on broader architecture, security, and production-readiness decisions.


 Maintain quality and reliability (15%)

Write readable, modular code; add useful tests; debug issues across the stack; document important decisions; and support solutions after launch.


 Collaborate and learn(5%)

Work with business stakeholders, product owners, senior engineers, and other technology teams. Share reusable prompts, patterns, components, and lessons learned.

What Good Looks Like

  • You can break down a broad business problem, define the first useful solution, and deliver a working result.
  • You use AI tools fluently but do not outsource judgment to them.
  • You can explain your code, debug it, test it, and improve it after feedback.
  • You communicate trade-offs clearly to both engineers and business users.
  •  You recognize when to keep a solution simple and when to ask for senior engineering guidance.

 
Qualifications

Experience

We are looking for someone who has:

  • 3-5 years of professional software development experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
  • A track record of shipping working software, whether in production roles, substantial internships, or serious personal projects.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools as part of a real engineering workflow, or clear evidence of adopting them quickly and responsibly.
  • Comfort working through ambiguity, making pragmatic trade-offs, and communicating clearly with both engineers and business users.


 Required:

  • Strong coding fundamentals, including data structures, APIs, debugging, testing, and basic software design.
  • Working ability in at least one general-purpose programming language used for production software, ideally Python, TypeScript, or JavaScript.
  • Familiarity with SQL, relational data modeling, web applications, REST APIs, Git, pull requests, and code review.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools, or clear evidence that you can adopt them quickly and responsibly.
  • Ability to work through ambiguity, ask good questions, make pragmatic trade-offs, and communicate clearly.


Preferred:

  • Experience with Python, FastAPI, TypeScript, React, Svelte, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Docker, or cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.
  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems and APIs such as Microsoft Graph, SharePoint, Jira, ServiceNow, Slack, or Teams.
  • Familiarity with LLM application patterns such as structured outputs, tool calling, retrieval, evals, prompt versioning, guardrails, memory, and human approval flows.
  • Experience building internal tools, workflow products, business process software, or AI-enabled applications.
  • Exposure to Power Platform, RPA tools, n8n, Zapier, or Make is helpful but not required.

Primary Research is an important capability for Bain, helping teams build a clear view of markets, customers, and the questions our clients are working through. WHAT YOU'LL DO

Technical

Infrastructure Architecture & Automation – 30%
